assertions.assertion: States that events are NOT enabled by default and enables RaiseSuccessEvents, RaiseFailureEvents, RaiseErrorEvents, and RaiseInformationEvents in AddIdentityServer
assertions.rationale: Enables all four Raise* flags and states IdentityServer won't emit events unless turned on / by default nothing is emitted.

assertions.assertion: Implements and registers a custom IEventSink (e.g. AddTransient<IEventSink, ...>) for Seq
assertions.rationale: Implements SeqEventSink : IEventSink and registers it via AddTransient<IEventSink, SeqEventSink>().

assertions.assertion: Warns that a custom IEventSink replaces the default ASP.NET Core logger sink (each event goes to exactly one sink), so the custom sink must forward to logging to keep log output
assertions.rationale: Never mentions that a custom sink replaces the default logger sink or the one-sink-per-event rule. It logs via ILogger incidentally but does not warn about losing default log output.

assertions.assertion: Explains that UI login success/failure events must be raised by your own UI code via IEventService.RaiseAsync, since IdentityServer only raises protocol events itself
assertions.rationale: Incorrectly implies enabling success/failure events captures logins automatically ('confirm your login page surfaces the relevant events'). Does not explain that UI login events must be raised by your own code via IEventService.RaiseAsync.
